interface.description: which of the retrieval interfaces answers this question natively. Optional: absent means "search", which is how every question was graded before this field existed. Declaring an interface does NOT remove the question from the search harness — it is still issued to search_evidence and graded identically, and the routed answer is reported in a separate block.

interface_input.description: arguments for the declared interface. resolve: {"identifier": "23-0314.05"} (a document id, source path, or approval number). facts: {"fact_type": "expiration_date", "conditions": {...}, "manufacturer": "...", "limit": 50}. Ignored when interface is "search". This is routing input, never an expected answer.

at.description: resolve: which member was effective on this date

as_of.description: resolve: the date expiry is judged against

answerable.description: false for no_answer questions: the corpus must NOT contain this

expected_documents.description: repo-relative source paths; >1 for comparison/conflict questions

expected_pages.description: source_path -> 1-based page numbers that carry the evidence

expected_answer_terms.description: literal strings that MUST appear in the retrieved evidence text for the answer to count as supported; keep them short and exact (e.g. "36", "Exposure C")

query_terms.description: the search string(s) a user would realistically type

method.description: exact command / how the page was read

quote.description: short literal quote from the source page
